book.name: MATTHEW
book.title: Id ash d Matthew Oꞌohana ab Amjed g Jiosh Alidag

content: Mash haschu d wabsh hemajkam ha‑mashchama
D am haꞌi dada g Palasi ch chehanig ha mashchamdam ab Jerusalem t amjed k ab kakke g Jesus hab kaijch,
“K haschu ahgch g m‑pionag pi ab hu wohog elid g haꞌichu ha‑mashchamadag g kekelibad? Neh, e o gegosid pi am hu t‑himdag oidch ha wapkonk g e‑nohnhoi.”
D hab kaij g Jesus ab ha wui, “M ahpim haschu ahgch pi ab hu wohog elid g Jiosh chehanig ch wabsh g hejel e‑himdag am hab junihim?
Id o d chehanigaj g Jiosh mo hab chuꞌig:

content.text: Ab g si has wo i ha elidad g e‑ohg ch e‑jeꞌe, Exodus 20:12

content: ch id ehp,

content.text: Mat hemho wo wa e muhkid hegai mat hedai wo sha s‑koꞌokam has ah g e‑jehj. Deuteronomy 21:17

content: Kum eda ahpim ha mashcham mat pi ab hu has wo ha elidad ch ab ha wui hab wo chei, ‘Mah ant g Jiosh hegai mat haschu ab d wo i chum em‑wuikamk.’
Kum hab masma im hu hab wabsh i wua g Jiosh neꞌoki ch am ha mashcham hegai mo haschu d wabsh oꞌodham ha‑nahtoi.
Bam wabsh s‑e junimk mam ab has elid g Jiosh. Kuki wabshaba g Jiosh hab em‑ahg ch hab kaij ihda matki g Isaiabad an oꞌoha:

content.text: Haꞌi idam mo d chum ni‑hemajkamga o hab kaij mo ab si has ni‑elid ch ab ni‑ihm.
K wabshaba g ha‑iꞌibdag si s‑kawpk ch si mehk ab ni‑amjed.
Pi o shaꞌi wohom ab has ni‑elid no pi wabsh g hemajkam ha‑chehanig ha mashcham hab chum masma mo d ni‑chehanig.”

content: Mash haschu uamhun g oꞌodham
D g Jesus ab hahawa i ha wai g hemajkam k hab kaij ab ha wui, “Ab g wo ni‑kaiham k wo s‑amich.
Pi at im hu hab wo i em‑juh g Jiosh heg hekaj mamt haschu wo huh k wabshaba im hu hab wo i em‑juh heg hekaj pi kehg em‑chegitoidag.”
Kuchd am dada wui ahchim k hab kaij, “Nap s‑mahch mat si e taht g Palasi heg hekaj map hab kaij?”

D hab kaij g Jesus, “Pi g has wo e tahtkkad ab ha amjed. Do chum em‑wanimeddam ch eda hab sha masma mo d pi neneadam ch chum ha wanimed g haꞌi ep pi neneadam ch atp hems am wabsh ha wehm wo i shul hiktani ch ed. Ni‑ohg Jiosh at gam hu hab wo i ha juh hab sha masma mamt wo huhpsh k gam hu wo nehnich g haꞌichu wuhshdag am e‑esha ed.”
D g Peter ab neok ch hab kaij, “Am g t‑ahgid maps haschu tashogid ch hab kaij mat pi im hu hab wo i t‑juh g Jiosh heg hekaj matt haschu wo huh.”
D hab kaij g Jesus ab t‑wui, “Kumt ahpim hab waꞌap pi koi shaꞌi amich hegai mani em‑ahgid.
Pi at im hu hab wo i em‑juh ab amjed g Jiosh mamtp haschu wo huh.
Heg at im hu hab wabsh wo i em‑juh ab amjed g Jiosh mat wo pi apꞌek g em‑chegitoi.

Heg at hab wo em‑juh mamt hab wo juh g haꞌichu pi apꞌekam. Neh, mtp hems wo ha mua o wo ha ehs g ha‑wehm kihkam o hab wo juh g s‑tohntom haꞌichu o wo haꞌichu ha ehs o wo haꞌichu ha iattogi ab hema i ep amjed o wo pi ap neo.
Id o d hegai mat im hu hab wo i em‑juh ab amjed g Jiosh. Pi at heg im hu hab wo i em‑juh mamt pi am hu ha‑chehanig oidk wo wapko g e‑nohnhoi k haha wo e gegos.”
Mash g gawul mahs oꞌodham uwi ab si hiwig g Jesus
Kuchd gam hu hahawa hihi Syria jewed wui k am miabi g Tyre ch Sidon kihhim.

D am hema d uwi ch pi d t‑wehm oꞌodham ch am t‑wui jiwia k hab kaij ab wui g Jesus, “S‑apꞌekam ni‑kownalig mapsh d Davidbad amjedkam, ab g si i s‑ni‑hoꞌigeꞌid. Ni‑chehiaga o g jiawul an uꞌukch ch si shoꞌigchud.”
D wabshaba g Jesus pi ab hu has shaꞌi kaij wui. Kuchd ab si ahgid mat hig wo cheha mat gam hu wo hih no pi an t‑oidahim ch si s‑nakosig.
D hab kaij g Jesus ab wui ihda uwi, “Heg o d waꞌi ni‑chikpan idani mant wo i ha wehmt g Tutuligo hemajkam.”
D ab ha hekaj i gei wecho ihda uwi k hab kaij, “Am g hig i ni‑wehmt.”
D hab kaij g Jesus, “Heg at wo wa wepok mamt ab wo ha mah g gogogs g ha‑chechmait g aꞌal.”
D hab kaij hegai uwi, “Woho o wa. T wabshaba chum hems g gogogs am wo huh g aꞌal ha‑haꞌichu hugi hahainig. Kunt ahni hab wa masma wo si s‑ap ni‑taht mapt id am hab wo al i ni‑juni.”
D hab hahawa kaij g Jesus ab wui, “Neh, m‑neꞌoki o am chehgid map ab si ni‑hiwig. T heg hekaj am hab wo e juh ihda map ab ni‑tahni.” Kutsh am waꞌi hekaj doa hegai chehiagaj.
Matsh g Jesus muꞌi hemajkam ha dodaj
Amjed achd gam hu hahawa ep hihi Galilee shuhdagi babsho. D g Jesus am i chesh kawulk dahm.
Kud muꞌijj am dada g hemajkam k am ha uꞌapa g pi hihimidkam ch pi neneadam ch pi neneokdan ch muꞌi nahnko mahs kokꞌodam. D g Jesus ha dodaj.
Kud si has i elid g hemajkam neidok mo neneok g mumio ch g pi hihimidkam oiopo ch g momjo hahawa ab wehsig ch g pi neneadam s‑ap haꞌichu neid. D wehsijj ab si has elid g Jiosh.
Matsh g Jesus ha gegos g giꞌik mihl chechoj ch muꞌi ehp

D g Jesus ab hahawa i t‑waid k hab kaij, “Neh, waik tashkaj in o waꞌi t‑wehmaj idam hemajkam ch heki hu waꞌi pi haꞌichu huh. Ni s‑ha hoꞌigeꞌid. Tp hems haꞌi wo s‑e chuhugi matp gam hu wo sha hihi pi haꞌichu hugok.”
Kuchd hab kaij ab wui, “Kuchs hebai hig wo ui g haꞌichu hugi id eda tohono jewed matt hekaj wo ha gegos g haꞌakia hemajkam?”
D hab kaij g Jesus, “Heꞌekia at am i wih g sismito?” Chd hab kaij, “Al wewaꞌak sismito ch al heꞌekia chuꞌuchum waptopi.”
D g Jesus am hahawa ha chehani g hemajkam mat wo dadhaiwua. Kud am dadhaiwua.
D am ha ui hegam wewaꞌak sismito ch waptopi k ab hoꞌigeꞌel g Jiosh k am i hahain k ab t‑mah. Kuchd an i ha mahkhi g hemajkam.

D wehsijj hug k oi wa hi si s‑kokwod chum as am hu hebai d giꞌik mihl chechoj ch muꞌi ehp mo d uꞌuwi ch aꞌal ch pi kuintas. Kuchd an hahawa i uꞌihi g wihpiꞌidaj mat am huꞌi wewaꞌak hoha wo ha shuhshud.
D g Jesus am hahawa ha ahgi g hemajkam mat gam hu wo hihi. Kuchd gan hu dadhaiwua wahlko ch ed k gam hu aigo i chehchsh Magadan chekshani am.
